title: The Model Update
brief: Meridian Advisory plans to roll out version 4 of its pricing model to all analysts next week. Change request MC-8 is due for approval. You have 12 visit points to assess the change for risks, controls, and records.

actions.label: General condition of the area
actions.note: Nothing of note for the purpose of this visit.

actions.label: A staff member: anything else to mention
actions.note: The staff member has nothing further to add on this topic.

actions.label: Older records for this area
actions.note: The older records show nothing relevant to this visit.

actions.label: Notices and signs in the area
actions.note: The notices are current and not relevant to this visit.

evidence.text: MC-8 states purpose, scope, and approvers.
Verification of version 4: 3 test cases run; no comparison with version 3 results on live engagements; no criteria (record VR-4).
evidence.whyItMatters: Model changes need verification against criteria.
evidence.missedExplanation: Ask what was compared and against what.

evidence.text: 2 client contracts (C-17, C-22) require notice before methodology changes on ongoing work.
Model library allows any analyst to save over the master file (permission set PS-1).
evidence.whyItMatters: Controlled documents must be protected from unintended change.

evidence.text: No plan to retire version 3 (MC-8 section 6 blank).
evidence.whyItMatters: Retirement prevents use of obsolete versions.
evidence.missedExplanation: Ask what happens to the old version.

evidence.text: Model risk assessment MR-1 is for version 2.
evidence.whyItMatters: Risks of the change must be assessed.
evidence.missedExplanation: Check the risk record matches the version.

evidence.text: Briefing plan is an email (draft BE-1).
The model owner is named in the role list and approved MC-8 for submission.
Version 4 uses a new colour scheme.

evidence.whyItMatters: Tone of internal email is not a requirement.

evidence.text: Model documentation for version 4 is complete with owner and version.

decisions.prompt: Should MC-8 be approved next week?
options: Defer with conditions: verification with criteria and parallel runs, client notice, master file protection, retirement of version 3, risk update, and training
Approve for new clients only without verification
decisions.rationale: The update can go ahead once the review is complete.

containment: Keep version 3 as master until MC-8 is approved
correction: Complete verification, client notice, protection, retirement, risk, and training
cause: The model change process lacks verification criteria and client and retirement steps
corrective: Add these to the model change procedure
effectiveness: Audit the next three model changes

debriefText.found: You checked verification, clients, control, and risk.
debriefText.missed: Ask who can overwrite a master file.
debriefText.falseFinding: Colours and email tone are not findings.
